summary: Prevent publication pending collisions and recover affected retained replica envelopes

replay.detail: A one-time store-open migration requeues retained envelopes with an invalid/internal record whose error is exactly UNIQUE constraint failed: local_publication_pending.claim_id. Normal backlog admission validates the original signed content.

schema.detail: Store open replaces publication pending enqueue triggers once with conflict-independent duplicate guards. A local meta marker makes recovery one-time and atomic with receipt requeueing; signed envelopes and record diagnostics are unchanged.

rules.detail: Existing membership, signature, repair and retired-envelope admission gates remain in force.

compatibility.detail: Existing stores receive the trigger upgrade automatically. Unrelated internal errors are not retried.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond a normal upgrade.

manual.detail: Routine backlog admission processes the requeued envelopes; no manual database edits are needed.

recovery.detail: Repeated opens do not requeue again, including if later admission fails. Original diagnostics remain until normal admission updates them.
